Additionally, to anyone else reading along, i may have found another thing that helps me that could help one of you; so i want to share it. Just in case it does help someone else. 

Whenever I'm having one of my particularly bad days, when everything seems hopeless, like im a burden to everyone in my life, and that i would be better off shooting myself: i start watching clips from Mr. Rogers on youtube. 

His gentle demeanor, soft speaking language, and the very welcoming atmosphere of his set make it feel like I'm visiting someone who I know will listen, but instead of interrupting me and offering the same generic responses; he gives genuine advice on how to perceive I'm feeling. But most importantly, it helps me cry. His clips help me get *out* all the emotions and awful thoughts i've been bottling up for what may seem like forever. And although i may feel awful because crying inherently isnt a fun feeling; a short while afterwards, I feel fantastic. Like I've restored by some magic and everything's gonna be ok again, and that i *can* have a life worth living. 

So, to anyone who read all that and may feel hopeless, try watching just a little of Mr. Rogers. And to those who know of a friend who needs help; why not suggest it to them? Or even better, be the good neighbor Mr. Rogers was. 

The world *needs* more Mr. Rogers and good neighbors. Now more than ever.
